name: Youth Open Source Special Fund: Seed Program
organization: Alibaba Cloud Developer Community and ecosystem partners
reward: Project funding for qualified open-source teams
summary: Funding-oriented program for small teams with an existing, OSI-licensed open-source project. It is not a guaranteed one-to-one mentor program.
